# Dependencies found here are linked by sibling project directories.
set(CMAKE_FIND_PACKAGE_TARGETS_GLOBAL TRUE)

find_package(GTest QUIET)
if (NOT TARGET GTest::gtest OR NOT TARGET GTest::gmock)
    set(INSTALL_GTEST OFF CACHE BOOL "Disable installation of bundled GoogleTest" FORCE)
    add_subdirectory(GoogleTest EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL)
endif ()

find_package(benchmark QUIET)
if (NOT TARGET benchmark::benchmark)
    set(BENCHMARK_ENABLE_TESTING OFF CACHE BOOL "Disable tests for bundled Google Benchmark" FORCE)
    set(BENCHMARK_ENABLE_INSTALL OFF CACHE BOOL "Disable installation of bundled Google Benchmark" FORCE)
    add_subdirectory(GoogleBenchmark EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL)
endif ()

find_package(spdlog QUIET)
if (NOT TARGET spdlog::spdlog)
    set(SPDLOG_BUILD_TESTS OFF CACHE BOOL "Disable tests for bundled spdlog" FORCE)
    set(SPDLOG_BUILD_EXAMPLE OFF CACHE BOOL "Disable examples for bundled spdlog" FORCE)
    set(SPDLOG_BUILD_BENCH OFF CACHE BOOL "Disable benchmarks for bundled spdlog" FORCE)
    set(SPDLOG_INSTALL OFF CACHE BOOL "Disable installation of bundled spdlog" FORCE)
    add_subdirectory(Spdlog EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL)
endif ()

find_package(asio QUIET)
if (NOT TARGET asio::asio)
    add_library(asio INTERFACE)
    # Keep bundled Asio ahead of system include directories to avoid mixing header ABIs.
    set_target_properties(asio PROPERTIES SYSTEM FALSE)
    target_include_directories(asio INTERFACE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/Asio/asio/include)
    target_compile_definitions(asio INTERFACE ASIO_STANDALONE)
    find_package(Threads REQUIRED)
    target_link_libraries(asio INTERFACE Threads::Threads)
    # find_package(OpenSSL REQUIRED)
    # target_link_libraries(asio INTERFACE OpenSSL::SSL OpenSSL::Crypto)
    add_library(asio::asio ALIAS asio)
endif ()
